audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows disagreed between layers. phases[].side read Fizz/Fizz/Skill/Skill/Fizz/Skill/Skill; win[] read Akali/Akali/Akali/Fizz/Akali/Fizz/Akali.
audit.why: 51.59% over 3024 games is a slight Akali edge. Akali genuinely owns 1-3: Urchin Strike needs a target to dash to and Playful/Trickster is 16s at rank 1. Fizz owns 4-6 as the hop falls to 10s, Seastone Trident empowers every 4s, and Chum the Waters opens from 1300 range. First item is a read, and late Akali reasserts once she waits the 8-second hop out.
audit.corrected: Reconciled chart, both layers, matched pairs: Akali, Akali, Akali, Fizz, Fizz, Skill, Akali.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as favouring Akali 'on paper since her all-in is faster'. It is Fizz's spike: Chum the Waters reaches 1300, more than double Akali's 675 R range, and the shark knocks up.
audit.why: Riot's R text: the fish attaches to any champion that touches it and slows, then a shark erupts and knocks up the target. Range 1300, cooldown 120/100/80. Nothing in Akali's kit closes that first.
audit.corrected: phases[4] flipped to Fizz with a grounded why, whys[4] rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeated 'the untargetable hop dodges your combo' four times without ever giving its cooldown, and never mentioned Nimble Fighter at all — Fizz moves through units and takes flat reduced damage from every source, so a wall of minions is not spacing against him and chip damage is blunted.
audit.why: Both facts are stated plainly in Riot's descriptions. The brief's missingInteractions also flags Seastone Trident as an auto-attack-reset burst tell, which was likewise absent.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, enemyWin and the phase whys rewritten to carry Nimble Fighter, the 16s-to-8s hop, and Seastone Trident's 4-second empower.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Count it out loud if you must' with no number to count.
audit.why: Playful/Trickster is 16/14/12/10/8 — the single most important number in this lane, and it halves over the lane's course. Chum the Waters is 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Real numbers now in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, phases[2].why, phases[3].why, phases[6].why and whys[2], whys[3], whys[6].

edits.before: Q the wave edge and his toes — the energy crunch is real, so every kama needs to farm AND poke at once.
edits.after: His only level 1 tool is Urchin Strike, and it needs a target — hold 550 spacing and the wave is yours.

edits.before: More Q pressure — hold the energy bar above 100 so a real trade window never finds you broke.
edits.after: Nimble Fighter walks him through minions, so a minion wall never stops him. Space by distance.

edits.before: Shroud online: the trade pattern is Q-auto, shroud the answer, Q again from the smoke. Most mids lose this exchange.
edits.after: Shroud online, and Playful/Trickster is 16s at rank 1 — the widest his untargetable window will ever be for you.

edits.before: Passive-weave every trade: spell, walk out of the ring, auto the edge — the energy refunds pay the whole lane.
edits.after: Playful/Trickster falls to 10s and Seastone Trident empowers every 4s — his trade pattern now out-paces yours.

edits.before: Perfect Execution online — the double-dash R turns half-health mages into clean-up duty. Look for the all-in.
edits.after: Chum the Waters attaches from 1300 and the shark knocks you up — he opens the level 6 fight from outside your range.

edits.before: First item spike: shroud trades become kill threats. Force the wave contact and punish every spell he whiffs.
edits.after: First item evens it: your burst kills him, his untargetable hop eats it. Whoever guesses the E right wins.

edits.before: Late Akali erases carries: R in through the front line, shroud the response, E-reset out with the kill.
edits.after: Late, wait the 8-second hop out, then R in, shroud his answer, and E-reset out with the kill.

edits.before: Akali: at level 1 Akali's poke and trade pattern already outperform Fizz's setup-dependent kit.
edits.after: Akali: Urchin Strike needs a target to dash to, so level 1 spacing keeps Fizz off her entirely.

edits.before: Akali: level 2 keeps favoring Akali as Fizz still lacks reliable engage tools.
edits.after: Akali: Fizz has no untargetable hop at level 2, so her Q chip goes unanswered.

edits.before: Akali: level 3 gives Akali a full combo that beats Fizz's still-developing trident procs.
edits.after: Akali: level 3 gives Akali a full combo while Playful/Trickster is still a 16-second cooldown.

edits.before: Fizz: levels 4-5 shift in Fizz's favor as Trident stacks and E dodge timing start punishing Akali's dives.
edits.after: Fizz: levels 4-5 shift to Fizz as Playful/Trickster falls to 10s and Seastone Trident empowers every 4s.

edits.before: Akali: level 6 favors Akali on paper since her all-in is faster, provided she baits the E first.
edits.after: Fizz: Chum the Waters attaches from 1300 range and the shark knocks you up before you can close.

edits.before: Fizz: first item Fizz's burst plus untargetability dodge can flip an all-in against Akali if she engages blind.
edits.after: Skill: your first-item burst kills him, his untargetable hop eats it — whoever reads the E right takes it.

edits.before: Akali: late game Akali's burst still kills Fizz first as long as she waits out his E cooldown before committing.
edits.after: Akali: late her burst still kills first, as long as she waits the 8-second Playful/Trickster out before committing.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Twilight Shroud has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, and it is 16s at rank 1 falling to 8s — bait it onto a minion before you spend burst. - Nimble Fighter walks him through minions, so a wall of bodies is not spacing. - Chum the Waters reaches 1300; the fish sticks on contact.

edits.before: The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, and it is 16s at rank 1 — bait it onto a minion, then commit inside that window.

edits.before: Fizz whiffs Playful / Trickster and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Playful/Trickster spent is up to 16 seconds of a melee target.

edits.before: That is Fizz’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Chum the Waters attaches from 1300 range — he starts the 6 fight, not you.

edits.before: The shroud spent farming is the dive you can't answer — W is your Flash, your Zhonya's, and your opening all at once.
edits.after: Urchin Strike dashes through you and Nimble Fighter ignores minions — you cannot burn both E casts and still leave.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Fizz survives one combo by hopping out of it. Force Playful/Trickster first, kill on the second window, E out.

edits.before: If Fizz takes first blood, tighten up: Playful / Trickster is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Fizz takes first blood, never step inside 1300 range of a banked Chum the Waters, and never commit into a fresh Playful/Trickster. Farm at Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Fizz wins by hopping untargetable through your burst, then opening from 1300 range with a fish you never saw stick.
